name: Seraphic Bastion Servitor
lore: A shield servant built around protection rites, deployed to preserve Empyrean order during Gate events.
visualDescription: White-gold shield construct with folded wing plates, opal joints, low-burning aura engine.
mapBehavior: Protects ranged units and counters reckless cleaves.
